summary: Live recount (202 review files, 01:11:00 snapshot): F1 4 (R2 5), F2a 2, F2b 2 full accepts at the current schema bytes. The published pass-06 reason 'F1 4 / F2a 3 / F2b 0' is stale in both directions within ten minutes: worker-075's F2a accept was rewritten to revise after the report, and two F2b full accepts (worker-090, worker-072) landed after it, discharging the published F2b blocker at live bytes. Two instrument defects are measured, not inferred: review files are unpinned so coverage is only valid at its measurement instant, and the controller's target normalization drops path#hash-target reviews and dict-valued pins (worker-089's F1 accept is invisible; F2b census 2 vs 10). Recommended repairs: (1) gate reasons carry the review-corpus digest and a decision-instant recount; (2) map path#hash/alias@hash targets and flatten dict-valued hash bindings in review_coverage, keeping control C8 (oracle agreement) in the regression set. Two runs byte-identical; 10/10 controls pass; no gate verdict claimed.
